# MakerPlanet

> Dummy online store for construction kits and educational toys, developed as a web layout and static frontend showcase.

## Overview
MakerPlanet is a fictional e-commerce platform focused on building blocks and construction toys, developed by Sergio Delgado López. The project uses Eleventy (11ty) as a static site generator, Vite for asset bundling, and modular SASS/SCSS for visual styling.

*Note: The primary project documentation and repository standards are in English, with secondary support for Spanish.*

## Brands & Categories
- **LEGO**: Thematic building block sets.
  - LEGO Star Wars
  - LEGO Harry Potter
  - LEGO Disney
- **Mega Bloks**: Construction blocks for early childhood development and thematic collections.
  - Mega Bloks Kids
  - Mega Bloks Hallo
  - Mega Bloks Dragons
- **Magna-Tiles**: 3D magnetic geometric tiles.
  - Magna-Tiles Kids
  - Magna-Tiles Desert
  - Magna-Tiles Sea
- **Meccano**: Metal and plastic engineering/construction kits with tools.
  - Meccano Race
  - Meccano Sky
  - Meccano Wheels

## Page Structure & Navigation
- `/index.html`: Main landing page featuring a hero slider, featured brands, advantages, and client testimonials.
- `/prod-lego.html`: Product catalog for LEGO.
- `/prod-megabloks.html`: Product catalog for Mega Bloks.
- `/prod-magnatiles.html`: Product catalog for Magna-Tiles.
- `/prod-meccano.html`: Product catalog for Meccano.
- `/detalles-prod-lego.html`: Detailed single product view.
- `/carrito.html`: Shopping cart summary.
- `/pagos.html`: Simulated checkout and payment gateway flow.
- `/contactanos.html`: Support and contact form.
- `/politicas-privacidad.html`: Legal information and privacy policy.

## Technical Architecture
- **Static Site Generator**: Eleventy (`eleventy.config.js`)
- **Bundler / Build Tool**: Vite (`vite.config.js`)
- **Styles**: Modular SASS/SCSS (`/sass/main.scss`, `/sass/mixins.scss`, per-page stylesheets)
- **Components**: Reusable HTML partials in `/_includes/` (`header.html`, `footer.html`)
- **License**: MIT
